title: new03, fts3 arm
live_proof: inspection in the 3.22.0 tree: fts3's segment writer binds zRoot SQLITE_STATIC into the cached segdir statement, steps and resets it, and sqlite3_reset() does not clear bindings, so parameter 6 still points at the buffer when fts3SegWriterFree() releases it. Fixed upstream in 3.23.0 (eab0e10304), sixteen days after 3.22.0 shipped
object: the fts3 segment writer's root buffer, still bound as parameter 6 of a persistent cached statement
lifetime_ender: fts3SegWriterFree() releases the buffer while the cached statement's binding still points at it
fidelity: real consumer, real allocator. Same upstream fix as case 22, kept as its own case because the two observables are independently reachable through different extensions
